evidence_or_gap: Static dock_count exists, but availability totals may differ. Historical capacity/outage series remains absent.
Available-bike and free-dock snapshots exist; coverage gaps, disabled equipment and operator interventions remain.
Zero bikes/docks reveal availability exposure, not how many customers arrived and left. Latent demand must be estimated.
bike_id links trips, but contains no purchase dates, maintenance history, retirement or customer identity.
No inspection schedule, work order, repair cost, downtime reason or spare-part inventory.
No staff move log, truck/depot, loading time, fuel, wage or capacity record.
No bike/dock procurement prices, useful lives, financing or replacement schedule.
No charged fare, subscription account, payment, refunds, tax, sponsorship, subsidy or local profit statement.
Daily proxy observations exist; city mapping and trace-rain treatment are explicit assumptions.
Coordinates support distance lower bounds, not road times, truck costs or feasible routes.
No theft/loss value, insurance/security, connectivity, platform or data costs.
